audience: support and sales teams that answer customers in a Rasayel inbox

useCases.title: Find open conversations and who handles them
useCases.text: List the conversations of the app with their state, channel and assignee. Open one conversation to read its contact and last message.

useCases.title: Check which teammates are active
useCases.text: List the teammates with their id, status and presence. Their ids are the appUserId values for sending a message on a teammate's behalf.

useCases.title: Review the contacts in the app
useCases.text: List the channel contacts with their name, username, blocked flag and creation time. Use the end cursor to load the next page.

useCases.title: Confirm the workspace before you act
useCases.text: Return the app that the key belongs to, with its id, name and company domain.

useCases.title: Reply to a customer in a conversation
useCases.text: Read the conversation first to confirm it. Then send a Markdown text message to the customer. The customer receives it when Rasayel accepts it.
